2027-06-06.title: Fourth Sunday of the Apostles
2027-06-06.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Judge rightly: hear the small and the great alike
Wash yourselves; learn to do good
Run so as to win the imperishable wreath
Love your enemies; be merciful as your Father is merciful
2027-06-06.verse: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.

2027-06-20.title: Sixth Sunday of the Apostles
2027-06-20.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The commandments of the Lord give life
All the nations shall stream to the mountain of the Lord
Do everything for the glory of God
Unless you repent, you will all perish
2027-06-20.verse: No, I tell you; but unless you repent, you will all perish as they did.

2027-06-27.title: Seventh Sunday of the Apostles
2027-06-27.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: You heard the sound of words but saw no form
The Holy God shows himself holy by righteousness
Let all that you do be done in love
Strive to enter through the narrow door
2027-06-27.verse: Strive to enter through the narrow door; for many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able.

2027-06-29.title: Saint Peter and Saint Paul, the Apostles
2027-06-29.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Elisha raises the son of the Shunammite woman
Love is the fulfilling of the law
2027-06-29.verse: He said to him the third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter felt hurt because he said to him the third time, “Do you love me?” And he said to him, “Lord, you know everything; you know that I love you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

2027-06-13.title: Fifth Sunday of the Apostles
2027-06-13.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: God's anger on those who do injustice
Trust in the providence of God
2027-06-13.verse: “Do not be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

2027-06-01.title: Third Tuesday of the Apostles · St Justin, Martyr
2027-06-01.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The kingdom of God is not in talk but in power
Do not put a stumbling block before the little ones
2027-06-01.verse: For the kingdom of God depends not on talk but on power.

2027-06-02.title: Third Wednesday of the Apostles
2027-06-02.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Shine like stars in the world
This is truly the Saviour of the world
2027-06-02.verse: They said to the woman, “It is no longer because of what you said that we believe, for we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this is truly the Savior of the world.”

2027-06-03.title: Third Thursday of the Apostles
2027-06-03.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: You are God's field, God's building
The seed is the word of God
2027-06-03.verse: But as for that in the good soil, these are the ones who, when they hear the word, hold it fast in an honest and good heart, and bear fruit with patient endurance.

2027-06-04.title: Third Friday of the Apostles: the Feast of the Sacred Heart of Jesus
2027-06-04.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Abram gives Lot the first choice
He was wounded for our transgressions
They will look on the one whom they have pierced
2027-06-04.verse: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once blood and water came out.

2027-06-05.title: Third Saturday of the Apostles: the Feast of the Immaculate Heart of Mary
2027-06-05.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Sarah shall give rise to nations
The Lord himself will give you a sign: Immanuel
Chosen in Christ to be holy and blameless
His mother treasured all these things in her heart
2027-06-05.verse: Then he went down with them and came to Nazareth, and was obedient to them. His mother treasured all these things in her heart.

2027-06-07.title: Fourth Monday of the Apostles
2027-06-07.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Daughter, your faith has made you well
2027-06-07.verse: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be healed of your disease.”

2027-06-08.title: Fourth Tuesday of the Apostles · St Mariam Thresia
2027-06-08.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Go from your country to the land that I will show you
When you come to serve the Lord, prepare yourself for testing
Crucified with Christ: Christ lives in me
Just as you did it to one of the least of these, you did it to me
2027-06-08.verse: And the king will answer them, ‘Truly I tell you, just as you did it to one of the least of these who are members of my family, you did it to me.’

2027-06-09.title: Fourth Wednesday of the Apostles · Mar Aprem (St Ephrem the Syrian)
2027-06-09.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: You shall be a people holy to the Lord your God
Moses, whose memory is blessed: the law of life and knowledge
God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit
You are the salt of the earth and the light of the world
2027-06-09.verse: You are the light of the world. A city built on a hill cannot be hid.

2027-06-10.title: Fourth Thursday of the Apostles
2027-06-10.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: There is one God, the Father, and one Lord, Jesus Christ
Even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs
2027-06-10.verse: But she answered him, “Sir, even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

2027-06-11.title: Fourth Friday of the Apostles · St Barnabas, the Apostle (Mar Barnabas Shleeha)
2027-06-11.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Make known his deeds among the peoples
Barnabas at Antioch: a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith
The right hand of fellowship to Barnabas and Paul
I am sending you out like sheep into the midst of wolves
2027-06-11.verse: for he was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith. And a great many people were brought to the Lord.

2027-06-12.title: Fourth Saturday of the Apostles
2027-06-12.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: We are the aroma of Christ to God
Moved with pity, Jesus touched the leper: “I do choose. Be made clean!”
2027-06-12.verse: Moved with pity, Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, and said to him, “I do choose. Be made clean!”

2027-06-14.title: Fifth Monday of the Apostles
2027-06-14.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Suffering was to make us rely on God
2027-06-14.verse: I have said this to you, so that in me you may have peace. In the world you face persecution. But take courage; I have conquered the world!”

2027-06-15.title: Fifth Tuesday of the Apostles
2027-06-15.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Blessed is anyone who takes no offense at me
2027-06-15.verse: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the poor have good news brought to them.

2027-06-16.title: Fifth Wednesday of the Apostles
2027-06-16.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-06-16.verse: But law came in, with the result that the trespass multiplied; but where sin increased, grace abounded all the more,

2027-06-17.title: Fifth Thursday of the Apostles
2027-06-17.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Called to share the glory of Christ
2027-06-17.verse: It is the spirit that gives life; the flesh is useless. The words that I have spoken to you are spirit and life.

2027-06-18.title: Fifth Friday of the Apostles
2027-06-18.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Put to death in the flesh, made alive in the spirit
2027-06-18.verse: but in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be ready to make your defense to anyone who demands from you an accounting for the hope that is in you;

2027-06-19.title: Fifth Saturday of the Apostles · Sts Gervasius and Protasius
2027-06-19.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The law is holy, but sin seized its opportunity
2027-06-19.verse: Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put in more than all those who are contributing to the treasury.

2027-06-21.title: Sixth Monday of the Apostles · St Aloysius Gonzaga
2027-06-21.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: How unsearchable are the ways of God
The tree is known by its fruit
2027-06-21.verse: For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.

2027-06-22.title: Sixth Tuesday of the Apostles · Sts John Fisher and Thomas More, Martyrs
2027-06-22.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: We have a house eternal in the heavens
The lamp is not put under a basket
Epistle (Sts John Fisher and Thomas More)
If you suffer as a Christian, glorify God
Gospel (Sts John Fisher and Thomas More)
The one who endures to the end will be saved
2027-06-22.verse: Yet if any of you suffers as a Christian, do not consider it a disgrace, but glorify God because you bear this name.

2027-06-23.title: Sixth Wednesday of the Apostles
2027-06-23.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The parable of the lost coin
2027-06-23.verse: Just so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.

2027-06-24.title: Sixth Thursday of the Apostles · The Birth of John the Baptist
2027-06-24.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Nathan says to David: You are the man
Before I formed you in the womb I knew you
When the fullness of time had come, God sent his Son
The birth and naming of John
2027-06-24.verse: All who heard them pondered them and said, “What then will this child become?” For, indeed, the hand of the Lord was with him.

2027-06-25.title: Sixth Friday of the Apostles
2027-06-25.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Give to the emperor what is the emperor's, and to God what is God's
2027-06-25.verse: They answered, “The emperor’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to the emperor the things that are the emperor’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

2027-06-26.title: Sixth Saturday of the Apostles
2027-06-26.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: I promised you in marriage to one husband, Christ
2027-06-26.verse: Do not judge by appearances, but judge with right judgment.

2027-06-28.title: Seventh Monday of the Apostles · Saint Irenaeus, Bishop and Martyr
2027-06-28.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Aaron bears the names of Israel on his heart
The lips of a priest should guard knowledge
Continue in what you have learned; all scripture is inspired by God
The Holy Spirit will teach you everything
2027-06-28.verse: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything, and remind you of all that I have said to you.

2027-06-30.title: Seventh Wednesday of the Apostles
2027-06-30.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Lead the life to which God called you
You cannot serve God and wealth
2027-06-30.verse: Whoever is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much; and whoever is dishonest in a very little is dishonest also in much.
